title: Buck Clayton and Lee Young stranded in Tracy
summary: Around 1936-37 Maxwell finds a bankrupt band including Buck Clayton and Lee Young in Tracy and his mother feeds them.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, that's the way it worked with those bands. I remember, you know, bands being down on their luck. This was after I'd gone down to Los Angeles about 1936 or '37. I saw four or five familiar faces standing around the street in Tracy one day and one of them said, aren't you Buck Clayton? And he said, yeah. He said, what are you doing here? He said, I'm here with my band and the promoters run out. No money and everything so they had Buck Clayton, Lee Young and about six of the others. They said they hadn't eaten for a couple days so I took them home to my house and my mother gave them all dinner.
The bands would travel. They'd just go up the coast and come down and say, look, you know, you've got a hall. We'll put on a dance for a certain percentage.
